column8: ["Give the broad ivory housing more weight with a substantial ceramic lip, a shaded skirt and a convincing contact shadow.","Enrich the largely blank surface with pooled glaze, subtle crazing and handled wear that make the ceramic feel fired and used.","Develop the repeated reddish seat rims into tangible fittings with dark brass recesses, rubbed highlights and worn rubber edges.","Add distinctive crafted details around the openings so the machine feels individually built rather than a uniform perforated slab."]

["Give the broad ivory slab richer glaze variation, fine crazing and rubbed patches; its mostly blank surface feels underpainted.","Paint the seat collars with sharper brass highlights, tarnished recesses and distinct rubber lips; the soft brown rings currently blur the materials together.","Strengthen the perimeter with a substantial ceramic bevel and deeper contact shadow so the housing feels heavy against the clay.","Add a few purposeful fittings or carefully painted construction details to give the repeated openings a more characterful, handmade machine identity."]
